summary.intent: Win the Lio 'Keep the Line Running' hackathon challenge for Soony: analyze the supplier/launch data, find hidden problems, and build a product (Lighthouse/ask-soony) where agents recheck the launch plan on each new data drop and act, with a polished demo UI for hand-in at 12:00 Sunday.
summary.outcome: Analyzed the data (Collector's Edition misses Sunday: overbooked art books, failed statues, packing speed; false-alarm magnets; new drops at 14:37), prepared briefing/interview docs, and built a polling-plus-agent pipeline and web app. Final stretch refined the UI: case flow 'How we got here' merged to main, routine step menu fix, phone layout and top-bar fixes. Nothing pushed in the last stretch (main ~14 commits ahead of origin) and live not restarted.

repo: Portal API has only three endpoints (files list, single file, archive.zip) and no notifications or webhooks; files change without warning and may be replaced under the same name, so poll the list and compare SHA-256 checksums.
Confidential portal data lives in gitignored data/ and .env; .env.example is committed with an empty token.

Routine steps are validated per trigger kind: 'Chase once if no answer' only works on routines watching messages awaiting an answer, 'Ask for a status' only on shipments; the server rejects others ('step 2 cannot be done on open decisions').
The API does not load .env on import, so new settings like ASK_VIEWER_TITLE need a helper that loads .env first or they are missing after restart.
Team workflow files CLAUDE.md and PROGRESS.md exist; tasks are claimed via a 'Now' line in PROGRESS.md.
The case-flow component reuses the routine diagram's connector and node box exported from FlowGraph.tsx so both are drawn by the same code.
Live (:8000) serves the rebuilt web app immediately, but new server endpoints need a restart; demo runs at ask-soony-demo.stenglein.dev with record-only email.

Lucas's new-approach branch: only 'read new documents before verifying' is worth porting; its escalation loop duplicates main's loop and card_alerts.py, and pulse-console would bypass the duplicate-send guard and record-only mode.

code.finding: New 'How we got here' flow built from the case's own data (portal, reader, verifier, prediction, approval rule, decision, then); steps missing from the data are omitted; single top-to-bottom column because a two-column snake read confusingly.
Pulse-style describe chat on branch jonas/pulse-ui (POST /api/routines/describe); duplicated the existing 'change in your words' box and was merged then reverted, left parked.

workflow: Entire only writes a checkpoint when repo files change; sessions with only reads show 'no files modified, skipping checkpoint'.

Use separate branch worktrees (ask-soony-pulse, ask-soony-flow) and preview servers on a copy of demo state with background off and email recorded only, then screenshot at desktop and phone sizes before merging.
Check interview notes and user feedback before building UI: misreading what the team liked in Pulse (flow view, not chat) wasted a merge and revert.
Subagents are useful for parallel verification (200 order confirmations and 59 scans cross-checked) and logo variant drawing without touching the repo.

friction: Misread the Pulse request, built a duplicate chat, merged it, and had to undo the merge.
The two-column snake flow layout confused readers (second row right to left) and needed a redo.
The 'Add step' menu offered steps that could never work on some routines, making it look broken.
Phone layout issues: empty gaps, action bar overlapping options, and a crowded top bar needing a 3-column grid.
Mock Enter/Hide timing: hand-in deadline of 12:00 pressed while many UI polish requests kept arriving.
The data-drop timing and the supplier-sender registration depended on the user, and the token initially blocked data access.
open_items: Push main (about 14 commits ahead of origin) and restart live so the sign-in choice, Maren's 'Waiting for your OK', the heartbeat and new endpoints appear.
Port Lucas's 'read new documents before verifying' step into runner.run_pipeline with safeguards (skip without a model, keep try/except), tested on a copy of state.
Redesign Routines page: compact list rows with MiniFlow, one open at a time, ⋯ menu, duplicate-routine detection.
Support 'send email, then chase once if no answer' on decision routines via a reply-watching follow-up.
Choose and apply a Lighthouse logo (assistant favors variant 3, subagent favors variant 2) to favicon, top bar and sign-in.
Optionally make 'All cases' on phone a bottom sheet opened from the top bar.
Send the Karton Nowak art-book order and the Boise reply through the product once a sender address is registered; register sender emails in portal Settings.
Pitch deck and video still open; the Claude doc and the Briefing page still reflect the 14:00 state; optionally delete the earlier Claude doc.
Ask Lio engineers whether portal data is identical across teams and whether supplier replies create portal files; change the portal password that was posted in Discord.
